text:
olivia: Heads-up: we enabled a short-circuit sampler that omits numeric x-sample-rate and emits x-sample-flag:aggressive for throttled requests. Some SDKs treat missing numeric as 0 so dashboards show 0%.
samir: Can you confirm header shapes?
olivia: Two cases: 1) normal: `x-sample-rate: 0.1` 2) short-circuit: no x-sample-rate, `x-sample-flag: aggressive`.
dina: Quick SDK guidance: prefer numeric if present and >0, else map flag->fallback. Will push opt-in patches for Py/TS/Go.
samir: TS snippet I'll use: ```ts
const n = Number(h['x-sample-rate']);
if (!Number.isNaN(n) && n>0) return n;
return cfg.flagMap[h['x-sample-flag'] as string] ?? cfg.defaultRate;
```
dina: Python will add a small SampleResolver class with same semantics and env opt-in.
core-api-bot: Note: backend emission toggled by feature-flag `sampler-mode-v2`. No DB migration required.
olivia: Rollout plan: 5% canary -> 24h -> 25% -> monitor 72h -> global. Console will show a new "Mode" badge next to rate.
samir: Add integration test: missing numeric header should not zero metrics. I'll add to e2e harness.
dina: Changelog text: "Client libraries will now honor x-sample-flag when numeric rate is missing; upgrade SDKs to avoid 0% dashboard artifacts."
olivia: OK, target to merge opt-in SDK PRs today and flip 5% canary tomorrow morning. I'll post updates in #release-war-room.
